objective: At fixed M8/M46 default solved physics, attribute the low-gate default-versus-DirectCurrent terminal shift and its matched-NWell trend to Sentaurus contact-associated doping-well topology, well-volume SRH charge generation, and the remaining doping-well-surface versus contact-surface redistribution.

closed_topics: M51 CurrentWeighting and M52 DirectCurrent six-state attribution

fixed_state_policy.input_tdr: the exact frozen M8 input_fps.tdr for each device
fixed_state_policy.physics: EffectiveIntrinsicDensity(OldSlotboom); Silicon Mobility(PhuMob HighFieldSaturation Enormal); Silicon Recombination(SRH(DopingDependence))
fixed_state_policy.solve_path: Poisson, coupled Poisson/Electron/Hole, drain continuation to the contracted drain bias, then gate continuation from 0 V to 2.5 V
fixed_state_policy.terminal_current_algorithm: Sentaurus default; CurrentWeighting and DirectCurrent are both absent
allowed_deck_changes: add a top-level diagnostic CurrentPlot Tcl block
add a Plot block containing the M47 state fields plus DopingWells
add NoOverWrite snapshots only at Vg=0.00, 0.05, and 0.10 V
fixed_state_policy.full_terminal_replay: all 816 default Id-Vg points must reproduce the frozen M8/M46 terminal files
fixed_state_policy.shared_state_field_replay: the n19/n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.00/0.05/0.10 V fields shared with M47 must remain pointwise identical

doping_well_diagnostics.seed_rule: each fixed seed must lie inside the semiconductor doping well uniquely associated with the named contact in every input TDR; no state-specific or device-specific seed fitting
doping_well_diagnostics.authoritative_domain: Sentaurus CurrentPlot Operation=Integrate DopingWell=(x y) with IntegrationUnit=cm
doping_well_diagnostics.well_area_formula: integral of constant one over the contact-associated doping well
doping_well_diagnostics.well_srh_formula: integral of srhRecombination over the contact-associated doping well
doping_well_diagnostics.electron_srh_charge_current_A_per_um: -q times the 2-D cm-domain SRH integral times 1e-4
doping_well_diagnostics.hole_srh_charge_current_A_per_um: +q times the 2-D cm-domain SRH integral times 1e-4
doping_well_diagnostics.surface_redistribution_definition: for each carrier and contact, default terminal current minus frozen M53 DirectCurrent terminal current minus that carrier's signed well SRH charge-current term
doping_well_diagnostics.total_identity: default-minus-Direct total current equals electron plus hole surface redistribution because the opposite signed SRH charge-current terms cancel
doping_well_diagnostics.plot_field: DopingWells integer-valued contact-associated well index and support

controls: matched low-NWell n19 at Vg=0.00, 0.05, and 0.10 V
all four matched NWell pairs at both drain voltages
terminal_metrics: electron, hole, and total default-minus-Direct shifts

classifications.stable_well_topology_surface_redistribut: all diagnostics and invariants pass, matched low/high NWell devices retain equivalent contact-associated well topology within the frozen area tolerance, and the total default-minus-Direct shift is exactly carried by the surface redistribution residual
classifications.nwell_changes_well_topology_surface_redi: all diagnostics and invariants pass, at least one matched low/high NWell pair changes a contact-associated well support or area beyond tolerance, while the total shift remains surface-redistribution carried
classifications.well_generation_material_for_carrier_com: well SRH is material relative to one or more electron or hole default-minus-Direct shifts but cancels from total current; topology is reported separately
classifications.mixed_well_attribution: the required observables exist but no preceding classification rule is satisfied
classifications.internal_well_observable_unavailable: Sentaurus does not expose one or more frozen DopingWell domain or field observables needed by the contract
classifications.state_or_terminal_replay_mismatch: the diagnostic replay changes a frozen terminal curve or any shared M47 field

analysis.claim_guard: M55 attributes the frozen default terminal observation only. It does not declare a Sentaurus or Vela defect and does not authorize a production current-definition change.

forbidden_work: HFS, SG, quasi-Fermi, BGN, SRH-model, mobility, contact-model, mesh, electrode, or solve-path changes
CurrentWeighting or DirectCurrent in the M55 replay deck
device-specific, bias-specific, or state-specific doping-well seed fitting
required_artifacts: frozen contract and upstream hash manifest
machine-readable report, evidence manifest, regression test, and human-readable report
